[[File:Bask_Sunn_makes_an_offer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Bask Sunn]], a [[Dar'manda]] recruitment officer]]
'''Recruitment officers''', also known as '''recruiting officer''', were officials assigned with enlisting new recruits.

The [[Dar'manda]] member [[Bask Sunn]] served as a recruitment officer, traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] searching for new members for the group.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also used officers as [[Imperial recruiter]]s.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Limna Renence]] served as recruiting officer in the [[Imperial Navy Recruitment|recruitment office]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>
